title: Construct Validity of Coding Benchmarks for LLM-based Agentic Coding Tools
abstract: arXiv:2611.05665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software developers increasingly adopt LLM-based agentic coding tools to assist them with development tasks. To provide developers with up-to-date information on these tools' effectiveness, prior work introduced benchmarks that enable comparisons across tools. Despite the widespread adoption of such benchmarks, however, recent work has shown that they suffer from issues threatening their validity. Aims. In this work, we aim to complement prior work by analyzing the construct validity of agentic coding benchmarks. Methodology. We analyze nine benchmarks commonly used to evaluate the effectiveness of agentic coding tools. We identify the constructs that the benchmarks claim to measure, the metrics used to operationalize them, and potential confounders that interfere with the measurement. Results. translated_title: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编程工具之编程基准测试的构念效度研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.05665v1 公告类型：new 摘要：软件开发人员越来越多地采用基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编程工具来协助他们完成开发任务。为了向开发人员提供有关这些工具有效性的最新信息，先前的工作引入了可用于跨工具比较的基准测试。然而，尽管此类基准测试被广泛采用，最近的研究表明它们存在威胁其效度的问题。研究目标：在本工作中，我们旨在通过分析智能体编程基准测试的构念效度来补充先前的研究。研究方法：我们分析了九个常用于评估智能体编程工具有效性的基准测试，识别了这些基准测试声称测量的构念、用于操作化这些构念的指标，以及干扰测量的潜在混淆因素。研究结果：我们的发现表明，这些基准测试通常仅用一小组指标来操作化诸如“编程能力”等宽泛的概念。所报告的
tldr: 本文通过分析九个常用的智能体编程基准测试的构念效度，发现这些基准测试往往仅用少量指标来操作化“编程能力”等宽泛概念，并存在干扰测量的混淆因素，从而揭示了现有基准测试在效度上的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the construct validity of nine agentic coding benchmarks, revealing that they commonly operationalize broad concepts such as coding capability with only a small set of metrics and suffer from confounders that threaten the validity of their measurements.
